title: QPACK RFC 9204 Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, QPACK milestone and instruction-stream tests, HTTP/3 QPACK error-matrix tests, QPACK primitive benchmark Dry validation, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the standalone RFC 9204 QPACK floor.
scope: This verification covers the standalone QPACK floor: prefixed integers, string literals, the static table, field-section encoding and decoding, dynamic-table accounting, blocked-stream synchronization, and incremental encoder/decoder instruction parsing. It does not verify HTTP/3 request/response semantics or runtime stream-state capture/restore behavior in the HTTP/3 layer.
preconditions: The repo remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The QPACK module stays standalone and does not depend on Incursa.Quic.
expected_result: The focused QPACK tests pass, the requirement-home tests confirm trace linkage for the standalone RFC 9204 floor, core SpecTrace JSON validation accepts the new artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The standalone QPACK implementation is trace-owned by canonical RFC 9204 artifacts and is covered by focused milestone, instruction-stream, and error-matrix tests. The primitive proof for `REQ-QUIC-RFC9204-S2-0001` directly covers classified positive raw and Huffman string literal decoding, negative malformed prefixed-integer and string-literal encodings, and edge coverage for boundary prefixed integers plus static-table first/last/out-of-range lookups; `QPackPrimitiveBenchmarks` provides a permanent BenchmarkDotNet surface for integer, string-literal, and static-table hot paths. The field-section proof for `REQ-QUIC-RFC9204-S5-0001` now explicitly classifies positive static/literal-name encode/decode cases, negative truncated literal field-line decoding, and edge cases for duplicate field-line preservation plus deterministic output. The dynamic-state proof for `REQ-QUIC-RFC9204-S6-0001` now explicitly classifies positive dynamic table insertion, blocking, unblocking, instruction-stream synchronization, negative malformed dynamic references/instructions, and edge capacity, eviction, partial-buffer, and blocked-stream-limit behavior. On 2026-06-10, BenchmarkDotNet Dry validation for `*QPackPrimitiveBenchmarks*` completed successfully with six cases and `*QPackFieldSectionBenchmarks*` completed successfully with five cases; those Dry runs prove the benchmark surfaces compile and execute but are not performance evidence or a public benchmark claim. Runtime HTTP/3 stream-state capture and restore work remains a separate layer concern.
